**Language**
(for example "Spanish" or "Korean")

**Game language code**
Transport Fever 3 supports: `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt_BR`, `ru`, `zh_CN`, `zh_TW`.

Real Financial Statements already has: `en`, `ru`, `fr`, `de`, `pt_BR`, `ja`, `zh_CN`, `zh_TW`. Still missing: `es`, `it`, `ko`, `nl`, `pl`.

The mod can only follow languages the game itself has a code for. If your language isn't in the list above, say so and I'll note it, but I can't add it until the game does.

**Can you help translate?**
- [ ] I can provide the translation (I'll point you to the file)
- [ ] I can review a translation someone else (or a machine) wrote
- [ ] I'm just requesting it

**Notes**
The 73 on-screen strings live in `tcoleman_financial_statements_1/strings.json`. Translations in the mod today are automated unless credited; corrections to an existing language are welcome here too (list the string and the better wording).
